Centered at top, add title text 'Apply filter on 2-D  gray image  (K=1 Channel)' in Times New Roman Bold, ~36pt, color #C00000. 5. On the left (~9-50% width, ~43-88% height), draw a white-filled rectangle with a red #C00000 border. 6. At the top inside it, add 'e.g. Sobel 2-D filter' in a handwritten font (Comic Sans MS / Segoe Print), black, ~24pt, left-aligned. 7. Below the caption, insert the Grumpy Cat meme photo (cat on white bedding). Add white Impact-style all-caps text with black outline: 'I LOVE MATH' top-center of the photo and 'IT MAKES PEOPLE CRY!' bottom-center. 8. Overlay the 3x3 matrix on the photo in bold red serif ~40pt: row 1 '-1  0  1', row 2 '-2  0  2', row 3 '-1  0  1'; flank it with two large red '[' and ']' bracket characters sized to span all three rows. 9. In the center gap at ~65% height, insert a block right-arrow shape with white fill and red #C00000 outline. 10. On the right (~56-92% width, ~49-82% height), draw a rectangle with a red #C00000 border and place inside it the edge-detected (Sobel-filtered) version of the same meme: near-black #0A0A0A image with faint white edge contours, keeping the captions 'I LOVE MATH' and 'IT MAKES PEOPLE CRY' in the same white/outlined meme style. 11. Optionally add a tiny illegible watermark text box at the bottom-left of the right image to match the source.
